user.title: Philips WelcomeEye
user.description: Pick the intercom to add. Discovery is a UDP broadcast, so a device on another subnet or across a VPN will not appear here — add it manually instead.

manual.title: Enter the intercom details
manual.description: The device id (GID) is printed in the app under device information, and looks like cgab12cd34.

credentials.title: Sign in to {gid}
credentials.description: Use the same credentials as the WelcomeEye app.

data.password_is_derived: This password is already in the device's derived form

data_description.password_is_derived: Leave this off unless you recovered the 8-character derived password rather than the one you type into the app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the intercom. Check the address, and note that the UDT port is randomised — discovery must be able to reach the device.

abort.already_configured: This intercom is already set up.

data.av_wait: Seconds to wait for video before opening

data_description.lock_channel: Which relay the gate is wired to. 1 on the units seen so far; 0 is the door strike.
data_description.av_wait: The device ignores an unlock unless door video is live, so the gate button waits for it first.
data_description.punch_port: Only for paths where discovery cannot reach the device. The port is randomised and rotates, so a fixed value will eventually stop working.

no_video.message: The device will ignore an unlock without live door video.
